impact.text: No user can ever fully withdraw their deposited assets from any ProgressiveCurve market.

precondition_sources.text: A user requests a full withdrawal of their maxAssets from a ProgressiveCurve market.
The withdrawal must pass the MultiVault's full-balance checkout, leading the system to compute the necessary share reduction via previewWithdraw.
The state is such that square(shares) is strictly less than 2 × assets (non-perfect square).

intent_sources.text: A user requesting a full withdrawal of their maxAssets must not have the preview calculation hard revert; the withdrawal should complete without arithmetic underflow.
